answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that FTTT improves test-time computation scalability on two mathematical reasoning and two code generation datasets, using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include solutions to math problems and code snippets for programming tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use Exact Match as the evaluation metric as well as the verifier for math tasks and Pass@1 for code.
